name: product-definition-system
description: Define a product completely, at every level, as plain files: a spine of domains, capabilities and features, satellites for everything inside them, a typed graph between them, and a tool that keeps the definition honest.

scripts.check: node tools/pds.mjs meta check && node tools/pds.mjs docs --check && node tools/pds.mjs views --check --root examples/ledgerly && node tools/pds.mjs lint --root examples/ledgerly
